game_title: Modulo Gate – Lava Tube Tunnel Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Lava Tube Tunnel open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Lava Tube Tunnel open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round, lava imps strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel: keep the gates_open meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: gates_open drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while gates_open > 0.
